answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 21788 Country: India Title: I want to know the meaning of my dream. "In my dream, Me and my two office colleagues go for lunch to a hotel near my office, as the hotel is known to me its very affordable and budget priced hotel, after having the lunch, I tell my colleagues that i will pay the bill, but to my surprise the bill amount comes as Rs.9000/=. I get shocked from it, but i pay the amount to the hotel person but later on feel that the amount is too high as we know the hotel is a budget hotel and i ask the hotel owner to reason out why the bill amount is so high, i also think of an option to ask my colleagues to give their share as the amount is too high. after this i dont remember" please give the meaning of this dream, Question: Assalamualaikum, I want to know the meaning of my dream. "In my dream, Me and my two office colleagues go for lunch to a hotel near my office, as the hotel is known to me its very affordable and budget priced hotel, after having the lunch, I tell my colleagues that i will pay the bill, but to my surprise the bill amount comes as Rs.9000/=. I get shocked from it, but i pay the amount to the hotel person but later on feel that the amount is too high as we know the hotel is a budget hotel and i ask the hotel owner to reason out why the bill amount is so high, i also think of an option to ask my colleagues to give their share as the amount is too high. after this i dont remember" please give the meaning of this dream, Jazakallah. Answer ID: 21788 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 896/686/H=1431) It means that you are too much involved in the world and lagging behind in paying rights. You should turn your full attention towards reformatting yourself. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
